summary: The send/run slice matches the milestone scope: immediate work becomes a durable work item, the supervisor records a durable run lifecycle and linked session id, execution-target overrides win over stored agent defaults, and the always-on tool path excludes `ask_user`.

checks.name: durable work-item and run ledgers
checks.notes: The supervisor appends `work_item_created`, `run_started`, and `run_finished` facts to append-only ledgers and derives pending work plus visible run state from those facts.

checks.name: execution-target override precedence and linked Mu session creation
checks.notes: The effective tuple comes from the work-item override when present, and the default executor creates a real `SessionManager` session before prompting so every run has a linked `sessionId` even on execution errors.

checks.name: always-on tool selection excludes ask_user
checks.notes: The always-on tool-selection wrapper filters out `ask_user` after extension expansion, so the built-in ask-user extension does not leak into headless always-on runs.

checks.name: human-facing send/jobs/runs CLI surface
checks.notes: `send` prints job/run/session linkage plus the effective tuple, while `jobs` and `runs` provide inspectable summaries without reading raw JSONL manually.
